# Retain native JSON I/O provenance

| Assumption | Evidence / status | Consequence and smallest check |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A native codec error type proves malformed bytes. | DISPROVED by Witness's real io.Reader returning a syntactic-shaped or semantic-shaped closed-pipe refusal. | Preserve the source guard's existing provenance instead of granting authority by type. |
| Original error identity alone distinguishes source and grammar. | DISPROVED: errors.Is still reaches the I/O cause after the existing code strips its private marker, but the consumer sees an indistinguishable codec shape. | Keep the marker that is already created at the actual native operation. |
| This needs a new state model or another error identity. | DISPROVED by the existing private nativeJSONError. | Preserve its complete native wrapping and provide one query; no registry or new Core error. |
| Returning one matching nested native cause preserves all sibling causes. | UNVERIFIED for arbitrary callbacks. | Return the complete error tree, including joined context and native causes, rather than extracting one leaf. |

Fundamental contract: Go readers may return any error; its original identity and operation origin must survive codec wrapping. Bytes from a refused read are provisional. Product policy owns whether observed grammar is a finding. Primitive owns native I/O and its provenance. The smallest correction retains the existing wrapper, deletes the stripping helper, and exposes IsIOError. Witness consumes that query before codec classification, without any source-error catalog or prose matching.

Actual original native token/projection paths fail before the correction; all eight source-refusal leaves fail. The corrected selection reruns those failed leaves only; separate uncovered valid, empty, grammar, cancellation and writer boundaries prove non-admission and cause conservation. Retain all attempts and exact filter/seed facts. Follow targeted tools, a serial three-second benchmark with both same-run profiles, then three-second semantic fuzz. Publish before adoption. No independent or whole-product acceptance is claimed.

The first semantic fuzz phase failed after655 executions /7 new interesting inputs, minimizing to comma plus a late reader refusal. Go read ahead and reported grammar while omitting the already-observed source error. The promoted native input is testdata/fuzz/FuzzJSONIOProvenanceConservesNativeRefusal/271a8c351e62e468. This disproves the assumption that preserving Go's returned tree alone preserves every observed native effect.

The existing borrowed contextJSONSource now keeps only its first refused native read, and every cursor/object/document boundary conserves that cause beside the native result and withdraws a candidate. This is one error loan for the current source, not an event history, parser phase or population. Explicit Reset replaces the entire borrowed source, including that refusal. The existing projection-record replay already uses the same cause-conservation pattern. Grammar and original I/O identities coexist; actual EOF remains framing. Invalid native counts retain their typed JSON contract and guard provenance. No input extent, depth policy, timer or parser grammar is changed.

The nine native door/reset probe produced nine passing nodes and one failed validation leaf plus its parent: validation preserved I/O but had joined it before assigning its actual grammar contract. The corrected exact failed leaf passes with its original seed; the other eight door probes and Reset retain their unchanged passing proof. The promoted fuzz seed passes natively. Remaining phases measure the final source, not the earlier smaller correction.

Final runtime proof:132affected reset, bounded-document, projection and validation nodes pass; source-extent allocation and native Reset heap checks pass at4096/65536/262144, plus the production struct inventory. The final three-second provenance query benchmark measures315,485,887iterations at11.28ns/op,0B/op,0allocs/op; both same-run profiles verify. The corrected three-second semantic fuzz run records2560executions/28new interesting inputs, including the promoted original failure. Native stdout/stderr extents and digests verify against their receipts.

Both failures and their exact commands are in Anvil's dogfood log. Go-vet on the final source passes; the earlier successful staticcheck predates the source-refusal field and is not claimed as final-source proof. No analyzer bypass, waiver or acceptance claim.
